html:
Charlie Company Media is a digital marketing company committed to helping small business owners across the country break into online marketing and grow their businesses. To that end, we offer a variety of product packages designed to meet your business’s unique needs – get everything you want and nothing you don’t. That might be a website, SEO, and a range of advertising products, or it might be just a website.

Our digital marketing specialists can help you narrow down the products and package you need, but here’s a sneak peek at what we offer. Which would work best for your business?

Website Only:

This is our basic package that is a good starting point to get your business online. Think of your website as your online storefront.

  • Mobile-friendly website
  • Unlimited design changes
  • Free custom domain name
  • SSL-secured site
  • Monthly campaign reporting

Get Free Quote

SEO Package

This is our most popular package! Level up your website with SEO so you show up on search engines, like Google. We’ll also manage your directory listings across 100+ of the most popular online directories! Doing so helps to build your SEO authority and ensures every potential who finds you has your correct contact and business information.

  • Search engine optimization
  • Directory listing upkeep
  • Mobile-friendly website
  • Unlimited design changes
  • Free custom domain name
  • SSL-secured site
  • Monthly campaign reporting

Get Free Quote

Booster Package

Get the full digital experience with our SEO package + social media posting + review monitoring! Adding social media means our social media producers will manage your business’s profile for you, while posting relevant content twice per week. With review monitoring, you’ll get an email each time a new rating or review of your business appears online, allowing you to respond quickly and tactfully.

  • Social media posting
  • Review monitoring and alerts
  • Search engine optimization
  • Directory listing upkeep
  • Mobile-friendly website
  • Unlimited design changes
  • Free custom domain name
  • SSL-secured site
  • Monthly campaign reporting

Get Free Quote

If none of these choices sound like what you need, don’t worry. Charlie Company Media packages are completely customizable. Pick and choose the digital marketing products you want to create a completely personalized package! Our a la carte services include:

  • Website Design & Hosting: Mobile-friendly and responsive website with unlimited changes. Free custom domain name and an SSL-secured site are all delivered with a beautiful, professional website design.
  • SEO Services: Stay on top of your competition by getting found in search results on search engines like Google.
  • Social Media Posting: Use Facebook to reach new customers in your local market with fresh posts 2x/week.
  • Reputation Monitoring: Keep on top of what people are saying about your business online.
  • Directory Listing Management: We’ll make sure you show up in the most popular online directories and that they all have the correct business information listed on 100+ sites.
  • All-in-One Business Tool: Online scheduling, payments and invoices, customer management, email marketing, secure customer portal and more – all in one convenient app.
  • Website Retargeting Ads
  • PPC Ads
  • Social Ads

Fill out the form below to talk to a digital marketing specialist about the specific products you’d like to start using for your business.
